name: User interviews
job: The right users found and booked, and each call turned into findings
intro: User interviews starts from a question and finds who to ask among the people your team already knows: deals, what people said, your own contacts, a list you paste. It drafts an invite in your voice for each, notices the booking, and after the call proposes findings from the transcript or your notes, each a quote you keep or set aside, filed under its feature.
does: Say who fits in a sentence; the Lemma reads it into filters you can check, and ranks everyone with the reason they fit and what they said before.
Contact rules for the whole team: nobody invited twice in a month, rested after a no-show, never after they ask not to be.
After each call, findings with the quote and the minute, checked word for word; the ones you keep are counted by feature, in people.

accounts.why: Invites go from your own mailbox, one at a time, when you press Send.
Your booking page and your calls, read afterwards from your notes.
Optional: the call's transcript, read for findings.

setup: Once for the whole Lemma: the product findings are filed under, and the contact rules.
Each person: their mailbox, where a call's words come from afterwards, and their booking page, each a button in the app.
Or look around with a sample study: a reporting product and people at made-up companies, at every stage.
